_: Fourth real-trigger wiring — the NPC-gives-a-quest entry point. Talk to MFSE_Speaker in the Sleeping Giant Inn, pick the line, and its result script (MFSE_DialogueTrigger, extends TopicInfo) calls MFStoryEventDispatch.Fire(kw, player, speaker) -> SM ScriptEvent root starts MFSE_DlgTarget with Player=ref1, Speaker=ref2. Reuses the in-game-proven dialogue[] + placed-NPC pattern (follower/quest_stages); the only new piece is the Fire() in the fragment. Verify: `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, talk to the Forged Envoy, pick the line, then `sqv MFSE_DlgTarget` -> Running, Speaker alias filled. On an existing save dialogue needs a save/reload (the auto-written Seq/ handles new lines).
